author: MiYu
scope: One full native client using the published Main.js/Main.mscene, actual F1 skirmish input, continuous 45-second playback sample, pause/step/stop. Spatial variant also verifies grouped hierarchy UI, virtual End navigation, search scroll restoration, external selection and rename. Native viewport sampling includes rendering and scheduling; separate source-scene hashes identify the identity-group addition.

steps.name: native Toggle InputField and restart session

profile.note: WebView timing plus instrumented native editor-host/RHI call tree, memory provenance, and render-bound resources. GPU bytes are estimates; driver timing and process-wide heap sampling are not claimed.

memory.name: GPU HDR and multisampled color
memory.source: resolved RGBA16F plus MSAA RGBA16F and surface RGBA8 attachments; excludes driver allocation padding

memory.name: GPU texture residency
memory.source: render-bound texture dimensions x 4 RGBA8 bytes; mipmaps excluded

memory.name: GPU live scene views
memory.source: resolved RGBA8 and RGBA16F, depth/stencil and MSAA color attachments; excludes driver padding

browserCpuProfile.scope: Separate 10-second owned-QA Game playback after the canonical 45-second sample; leaf CPU time includes native/idle nodes and profiler overhead.
